column1: # tests/regress.tsv -- the regression suite's checks (tests/regress.sh). Tab-separated:
# tier: quick (small models, minutes) or full. ppl: expect = the baseline perplexity on wikitext-2 test (llama.cpp's
# llama-perplexity agrees within ~0.5%, K-quants ~1%: PLAN.md "Regression suite"), tol in percent; the chunk settings in
# args. fv: args = the llama.cpp reference dump (tools/ref_oracle), expect = the minimum cosine. pk: args = passkey
# options (pass keys at context lengths x depths). --update rewrites the ppl baselines.
# every quant type (a 0.6B model: the 1-bit, TQ and IQ2_XXS files are broken at this size, in llama.cpp too)
# Qwen3.6 / 3.8 (the main models), every KV cache type, and long context
# the 35B in every quant type present (2- to 5-bit, FP4 kinds)
# long-context retrieval (pass keys): 32k at 3 depths per KV cache type, 128k at mid depth (Qwen3.8-Flash reasons
# before it answers: asked as a ChatML turn, --n 400)
